title: Suspicious Tomcat Confluence Process Launch
description: The query checks for suspicious Tomcat process launches associated with likely exploitation of Confluence - CVE-2022-26134.
query: ('Log Source' = 'Microsoft Defender Endpoint Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ('Parent Process Name' like 'tomcat*' and 'Command Line' like '*confluence*') and ((('Command Line' like '*certutil*' or 'Command Line' like '*whoami*' or 'Command Line' like '*nltest*' or 'Command Line' like '* dir *' or 'Command Line' like '*curl*' or 'Command Line' like '*ifconfig*' or 'Command Line' like '*cat *' or 'Command Line' like '*net user*' or 'Command Line' like '*net time /domain*' or 'Command Line' like '*tasklist*' or 'Command Line' like '*-c ls*' or 'Command Line' like '*ipconfig*' or 'Command Line' like '*arp*' or 'Command Line' like '*ping*' or 'Command Line' like '*net view*' or 'Command Line' like '*net group*' or 'Command Line' like '*netstat*' or 'Command Line' like '*wmic datafile*')) or ('Process Name' = 'powershell.exe' and 'Command Line' like '-e*'))

ask_ai_prompts: Summarize the Microsoft Sentinel converted detection results and identify the highest-risk pivots.
